This confirms the requested numerical approximation even though the exact solution does not extend to x=2. q-120940: Euler's method with step size 1 produces y-values 2,2,4,12 at x=1,2,3,4. q-47787: only [1,5] is a closed interval on which log_2(x) is defined and continuous. q-73499: only [-1,0] avoids the discontinuity at x=1 and has a continuous function on the entire closed interval.
